scripts.build:apps: pnpm --filter catalog build && pnpm --filter cart build && pnpm --filter shell build
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -n "catalog,cart,shell" -c "blue,green,magenta" "pnpm --filter catalog dev" "pnpm --filter cart dev" "pnpm --filter shell dev"
scripts.start: pnpm build && concurrently -n "catalog,cart,shell" -c "blue,green,magenta" "pnpm --filter catalog preview" "pnpm --filter cart preview" "pnpm --filter shell preview"
